what: The catalog difference (after minus before) the candidate migration produces on a plane provisioned as 69df2f52 and applied by the live-shaped applying login, in the format of the Director's snapshot tool, for the sections the migration's privilege model decides. Implementer prediction (S-11 / AC-10); qa/factory/v1/manifest_rehearsal.mjs compares it with the tool's before/after reads on the developer applying-role plane.

why.role_memberships: PostgreSQL 16+: CREATE ROLE by a CREATEROLE login that is not a superuser grants the new role to its creator WITH ADMIN OPTION, INHERIT FALSE, SET FALSE, the bootstrap superuser as grantor; createrole_self_grant (set by part 000 to the constant 'set' for factory_owner only, '' otherwise) adds one grant from the creator with SET only. No statement of the migration grants a role membership.
why.default_acl: Part 000 revokes the applying login's own 69df2f52 entry for factory_runner in schema factory (ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES without FOR ROLE) and records factory_owner's global function entry without PUBLIC EXECUTE.
why.schema_acl: USAGE on schema factory for the three new roles; the CREATE factory_owner holds while the migration runs is revoked by part 990.
why.table_acl_69df2f52: factory_owner gets SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, REFERENCES on the eight 69df2f52 tables; the TRIGGER it holds while part 080 attaches the legacy guard is revoked there.
why.transient: REFERENCES to PUBLIC on five new tables (parts 010 and 070) and TRIGGER to factory_owner on the eight 69df2f52 tables (part 080) are granted and revoked inside the one transaction, on objects no other session can see before commit; they net to nothing.

table_acl.rule: added: for each of the eight 69df2f52 tables, factory_owner SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, REFERENCES (40 rows); for each relation the migration creates, its owner factory_owner and nobody else (no PUBLIC, factory_runner, applying login, API role or reader row). removed: none.

function_acl.rule: added: factory_owner EXECUTE on every new factory function, and EXECUTE for exactly one API role on each of its front doors; no PUBLIC, factory_runner or applying-login row. removed: none.
